title: Equality of the dynamical sets of two commuting transcendental entire functions
summary: In this paper, we study the dynamics of commuting transcendental entire functions $f$ and $g$, where $g$ is of the form $af^p + b$ with $a,b \in \C$, $p \in \N$, and $a \neq 0,1$. We establish that the escaping sets, filled Julia sets, and bungee sets of $f$ and $g$ all coincide. As an immediate consequence, we obtain in particular that the Julia sets of $f$ and $g$ are identical. Our theorem extends the 1998 result of Poon and Yang.
